facts.statement: The contract review for Rheinwerk must be completed by October 15.
facts.quote: Rheinwerk (Bhavin) — €88k, Munich — draft arriving tomorrow, by 15 Oct
facts.whyItMatters: The deal team has established a target date of October 15 for contract finalization within a backlogged review queue.

facts.statement: The project intends to reuse PipeKit tooling as was done for the Northwind project.
facts.quote: Pranav: PipeKit can be reused 'like we did for Northwind'
facts.whyItMatters: The reviewer must verify that the contract allows for the reuse of existing IP and whether specific licensing terms apply to PipeKit.

facts.statement: Kriti Data Labs is planned as a sub-processor for this engagement, though client consent has not been obtained.
facts.quote: Kriti Data Labs: subcontract (for Rheinwerk) is planned on this deal; no consent on file
facts.whyItMatters: Subcontracting requires explicit client consent and flow-down data protection terms which are currently missing.

facts.statement: The Data Protection Agreement (Annex 3) referenced in the deal documentation is missing.
facts.quote: Rheinwerk Analytics GmbH: DPA (GDPR Art. 28) incl. SCCs: missing (Referenced as Annex 3 but not attached)
facts.whyItMatters: A complete review cannot be performed without the referenced DPA which defines the legal basis for processing data for this Munich-based client.
